info.name: Resume RAG - Phase 12
info.description: Verification requests for MongoDB resume storage.

exec: pm.test('Invalid embedding is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('INVALID_STORAGE_INPUT'); });
pm.variables.set('embedding', JSON.stringify(Array.from({ length: 1024 }, function (_, index) { return index / 1000; })));

pm.test('Resume is stored', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Resume stored successfully'); pm.expect(body.resumeId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
